g.text: SATLIB Inductive Inference — Boolean Classifier Synthesis (ii8 / ii16 / ii32)
Synthesizing a compact k-term DNF formula from labeled positive (+) and negative (−) bit-vectors · 41 SAT instances (Kamath et al.)
Find k-term DNF f(u) = T₁ ∨ … ∨ T_k with:
Boolean vars choose which literals enter each term Tⱼ
• s(j,i), s̄(j,i): include uᵢ or ¬uᵢ in term Tⱼ
∀ u∈E⁻, ∀ j: at least 1 literal falsifies Tⱼ(u)
• Positive cover (length k): ∃ Tⱼ with Tⱼ(u)=1
100% consistent with all training vectors (E⁺ → 1, E⁻ → 0)
